explain: With every requester asking, the requester after the last winner always wins, so io_index goes 0, 1, 2, 3, 0, … and io_grant goes 1, 2, 4, 8, 1, …. last starts at 3, so requester 0 wins first.

With start fixed at 0, the rotate disappears and the lowest-numbered requester always wins. last is still written but nothing reads it, so synthesis removes its flip-flops along with the rotator. The result is smaller and shallower, but it is unfair: with req = 0xf, requester 0 wins every cycle.
